name: stw_endurance_path
note: Editable linear port of pi2ps5 STW path. Flow: Start → for each scene wait_anchor(found) → press/macro/delay → next. Skips 02_LOBBY DISCOVER_NAVIGATION. Interrupts (claim/dismiss/survey) are in stw_interrupts.

properties.heading: STW endurance path (linear)
properties.text:
EXEC flows top→bottom. Each row: wait for scene → press/macro → delay.
Not a priority scanner — interrupts live in stw_interrupts.
02_LOBBY Discover carousel is deferred.
LEGACY anchors: open wait node to preview crop; Freeze to retake full frame.

properties.heading: 00 — Fortnite title
properties.text:
MATCH: 'Press X to Start' / title splash (bottom-center).
THEN: press CROSS, wait 1.5s.
RETAKE: full title screen with the press-start prompt visible.

properties.heading: 01 — PS5 home / Fortnite icon
properties.text:
MATCH: Fortnite icon on PS5 home (top-left tile area); fallback = unselected icon.
THEN: press CIRCLE (runtime; config said CROSS).
RETAKE: home row with Fortnite focused or unfocused.

properties.heading: 28 — Discover search focused
properties.text:
MATCH: Discover search bar focused (top-left search field glow).
THEN: CROSS opens on-screen keyboard.
RETAKE: Discover with search field active/highlighted.

properties.heading: 29 — Virtual keyboard macro
properties.text:
MATCH: PS5 OSK / keyboard panel open (mid screen).
THEN: macro_block types SAVE THE WORLD then R2 submit (~15s timeline).
RETAKE: full keyboard visible; keep crop of keyboard chrome.

properties.heading: 30 — Search results → STW
properties.text:
MATCH: Islands search results header OR STW result card (any).
THEN: DOWN, DOWN, CROSS, CROSS to open first card.
RETAKE: results list after searching Save The World.

properties.heading: 04 — STW lobby ready
properties.text:
MATCH: STW title AND yellow Play (all / both templates).
THEN: TRIANGLE to launch/queue.
RETAKE: STW main lobby with yellow Play ready.

properties.heading: 05 — STW queued (wait)
properties.text:
MATCH: STW title AND cancel-matchmaking control (both).
THEN: hold/wait only — no press.
RETAKE: matchmaking / queued lobby with Cancel visible.

properties.heading: 06 — Connecting (wait)
properties.text:
MATCH: 'Connecting' text (bottom-left) OR lobby connecting art (any).
THEN: wait/hold through load.
RETAKE: connecting / loading into Fortnite.

properties.heading: 07 — Collect rewards
properties.text:
MATCH: Collect-all / rewards prompt (bottom-right).
THEN: TRIANGLE (runtime; config said SQUARE).
RETAKE: post-mission chest / collect-all HUD.

properties.heading: 08 — Hestia room
properties.text:
MATCH: Hestia logo / blue load room (bottom-right).
THEN: TOUCHPAD (runtime; config said CROSS).
RETAKE: Hestia spawn / blue interstitial.

properties.heading: 09 — Quests tab → Map
properties.text:
MATCH: Quests tab selected in old STW lobby (top tabs).
THEN: R1 to move to Map tab.
RETAKE: lobby with Quests tab active.

properties.heading: 10a — Stonewood on world map
properties.text:
MATCH: Stonewood logo on world map (left/mid).
THEN: RIGHT×3 + CROSS toward Twine.
RETAKE: world map focused on Stonewood.

properties.heading: 10b — Twine on world map
properties.text:
MATCH: Twine Peaks logo highlighted on world map.
THEN: CROSS to enter Twine.
RETAKE: world map with Twine selected.

properties.heading: 11 — Twine zone map
properties.text:
MATCH: 'Play with Others' / Twine zone chrome (bottom-left).
THEN: RIGHT + CROSS (runtime; config said UP+CROSS) to Storm Shield.
RETAKE: Twine zone map with PWO / SS node visible.

properties.heading: 12 — Twine Storm Shield selected
properties.text:
MATCH: Twine Storm Shield node selected (bottom-right panel).
THEN: CROSS.
RETAKE: SS node highlighted on Twine map.

properties.heading: 13 — Community Lookout modal
properties.text:
MATCH: blue Community Lookout / launch modal (bottom-right).
THEN: SQUARE.
RETAKE: that blue launch modal fully visible.

properties.heading: 15 — Yellow Launch
properties.text:
MATCH: yellow Launch prompt (bottom-right; triangle hint).
THEN: TRIANGLE.
RETAKE: STW lobby yellow Launch ready.

properties.heading: 14 — Travelling (wait)
properties.text:
MATCH: 'Starting Storm Shield' / travelling yellow banner.
THEN: wait only.
RETAKE: travelling / loading-into-SS screen.

properties.heading: 16 — SS loaded, not started
properties.text:
MATCH: Activate Storm Shield / SS loaded prompt (center band).
THEN: UP (runtime; config said TOUCHPAD) to open menu path.
RETAKE: inside SS before Endurance start.

properties.heading: 17 — Inventory → Shield tab
properties.text:
MATCH: Inventory top text / tab chrome.
THEN: R1×4 to Storm Shield tab.
RETAKE: in-game menu on Inventory tab.

properties.heading: 18 — Endurance menu/modal
properties.text:
MATCH: Storm Shield menu card OR Endurance modal title (any).
THEN: CROSS to proceed.
RETAKE: Endurance overview / start card.

properties.heading: 19 — Confirm Endurance
properties.text:
MATCH: final Start Endurance / confirm (bottom-right).
THEN: CROSS.
RETAKE: confirm dialog before waves.

properties.heading: 20 — Wave active (wait)
properties.text:
MATCH: Endurance/wave HUD text OR storm-shield active title (any).
THEN: wait through combat.
RETAKE: in-wave HUD (top banner).

properties.heading: 21 — Between waves (wait)
properties.text:
MATCH: defense prep / between-waves banner (top center).
THEN: wait only.
RETAKE: intermission countdown HUD.

properties.heading: 22 — Team score
properties.text:
MATCH: Team Score / endurance finished screen (top center).
THEN: CIRCLE to leave.
RETAKE: end-of-run scoreboard.

properties.heading: 23 — Matchmake homebase
properties.text:
MATCH: return-to-homebase / matchmake prompt (bottom-right).
THEN: CIRCLE to cancel/dismiss.
RETAKE: that homebase queue modal.

properties.heading: 24 — Rewards continue
properties.text:
MATCH: rewards continue CROSS hint OR open-chest art (any).
THEN: CROSS.
RETAKE: post-match rewards chest screen.
